title: Image Request Plan
description: Committed-safe contract for the source-document -> image-request bridge (scripts/source_to_image_requests.py). A Markdown source file is parsed into one image request per heading; each request carries SYNTHETIC-SAFE per-slide metadata (slide_title / alt_text / image_descriptor / placement_role / intended_use) plus structural traceability back to the heading (level + ordinal). The plan NEVER embeds raw source body text and NEVER triggers real image generation: it is a MOCK / LOCAL request plan only. real_image_generation_status is pinned to a self-describing NOT_PERFORMED sentence and the producing script refuses any source carrying credential / public-network / file-URI / absolute-path wording. This schema uses only the JSON Schema keyword subset that scripts/validate_artifacts.py implements.

schema_version.description: Plan-file schema version. Locked to '1'; bumped only with a paired emitter + schema change.

plan_id.description: Self-describing record identifier so a reader scanning mixed JSON evidence recognises this plan.

boundary.description: Fixed framing that this is a local-only mock bridge: no D-One, model API, public network, image search, or telemetry.

real_image_generation_status.description: Self-describing sentence pinned to NOT_PERFORMED: no real image generator produced these requests' pixels.

filename.description: Basename of the parsed Markdown source. Identifier-safe; no path separators, URI scheme, or '..'.

byte_count.description: Byte length of the source file.

sha256.description: Lowercase 64-char hex sha256 of the source bytes; lets a reviewer bind the plan to exact source bytes.

heading_count.description: Number of ATX Markdown headings discovered; equals len(image_requests).

title.description: Deck title derived from the first top-level heading (or the source stem). Capped at the operator contract's slide_title limit.

slide_count.description: Planned slide count; equals len(image_requests) for this one-image-per-heading bridge.

index.description: 1-based request index, contiguous in heading order.

image_ref.description: Render-model image_ref-safe token; also the placeholder filename stem in --mock-handoff.

filename.description: Placeholder image filename the mock handoff writes (image_ref + '.png').

slide_title.description: Human-readable title derived (sanitised) from the heading text. Capped at the operator contract's slide_title limit.

placement_role.description: Placement role (first request hero_page, rest local_region). In --mock-handoff it is written verbatim into the operator generated_provenance.json sidecar and drives the operator lane's role-aware layout: hero_page -> cover, local_region -> section_divider.

intended_use.description: Spot-illustration / icon style note. Never 'full-slide background'. Capped at the operator contract's intended_use limit. In --mock-handoff it flows into the operator manifest.json (intended_use) and the generated_provenance.json sidecar (intent_summary).

alt_text.description: Synthetic accessibility text; never raw source body. Capped at the operator contract's alt_text limit.

image_descriptor.description: Synthetic, abstract descriptor for a would-be image generator. Derived only from the sanitised heading, never raw source body. Capped at the operator contract's alt_text limit (no operator manifest analog exists).

source_heading_ordinal.description: 1-based ordinal of the heading among all discovered headings; structural traceability without raw text.

image_requests.description: One image request per discovered heading, in document order.
